addressed.change: Removed intermediate EUR quantization in convert_fx to compute (amount/rate_src)*rate_dst with only final rounding
Validate currency code length and letters on original string before upper-casing so expanding characters like ß cannot become valid

claims.title: convert_fx rounds the intermediate EUR amount
Currency-code length is checked after upper-casing, allowing length-expanding characters

addressed.change: Validate EUR==1 per entry before normalisation merge so duplicate eur/EUR keys cannot hide a non-1 rate.

claims.title: Duplicate normalised EUR keys can hide a non-1 EUR rate
Normalised duplicate rate keys silently overwrite earlier rates

contested.reason: The spec does not require first-entry-wins for duplicate normalised keys since it only says "Matching is uppercase-insensitive: codes (including `rates` keys) are normalised to upper case before use, so `\"usd\"` means `\"USD\"`" without defining duplicate resolution.
